paite: Huan Jerusalem a Rehoboam atuntouh in, Israelte dou a, Rehoboam gam la nawn ding in Judah nuaikhat leh Benjamin inkote, mihangsan chiat telkhiak, nuaikhat-le-singgiattak akaikhawm hi.
heading: Shemaiah Genkholhna / (1 Kum 12.21-24)

paite: Himahleh Pathian mipa Shemaiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
Judah gam kumpipa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kiang ah leh Judah gam leh Benjamin gam a Israel mi tengteng kiang ah,

"TOUPA'N hichi in achi: na hohtou ding uh ahi kei, na unaute uh dou sam kei un; na inn lam uah pai nawn vek un; hiai keimah hih ahi hi, chi in gen in," chi in. Huchi in TOUPA thu amang ua, Jeroboam dou ding a ahoh ding uh akik nawn uhi.
Rehoboam bel Jerusalem ah a-om a, Judah gam ah kivenna ding in khua asat hi.
heading: Rehoboam In Khopite Kulhbaang In A-um

paite: Bethlehem khuate, Etam, Tekoa asat a,
Beth-zur, Shoko, Adullam,
Gath, Mareshah, Jip,
Adoraim, Lakish, Azekah,
Zorah, Aijalon, Hebron khua; huaite Judah leh Benjamin gam a kulh nei khopite ahi.
Huchi in huai kulhte ahihkip a, heutute akoih a, nek ding, thau leh uain asekkhawm hi.
Kho teng ah lum leh tei akoih a, khua kiptak in abawl chiat hi. Huchi in Judah leh Benjamin gam ama gam ahisak hi.
Huan Israel gam tengteng a siampute leh Levite amau gam a kipan chiat in akiang ah ahong uhi.
heading: Siampute Leh Levite Judah Ahong Uh

paite: Levite'n agam uh leh a-omnate uh apawtsan ua, Judah gam leh Jerusalem ah ahoh uh; Jeroboam leh atapate'n TOUPA a dia siampu nna sem lou ding in atawpsak uhi.
Amun sang a ding leh keltal leh bawngnou lim abawl a ding a siampute aseh zawk ziak in.
Huan Israel nam, TOUPA Israel' Pathian lam a lungsim awn tengteng in azui ua, TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian kiang ah kithoih ding in Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi.
Huchi in Judah gam akipsak ua, kum thum sung Solomon tapa Rehoboam in akipsak hi: kum thum sung David leh Solomon lampi azui uhi.
Rehoboam in David tapa Jerimoth tanu Mahalath zi in anei a, huai Jesse tapa Eliab tanu ahihleh Abihail tanu ahi.
heading: Rehoboam Inkuante

paite: Tapate aneihsak a: Jeush, Shemariah leh Zaham ahi uh.
Amah nung in Absalom tanu Maakah anei a; ama'n Abijah, Atai, Ziza leh Shelomith aneihsak hi.
Rehoboam in Absalom tanu Maakah bel azite leh amite tengteng tung ah a-it tuan a; zi sawm-le-giat leh mei sawmguk anei a, tapa sawmnih-le-giat leh tanu sawmguk anei ahi.
Rehoboam in Maakah tapa Abijah, a-unaute lak ah makai lianpen in abawl a; kumpipa ding a bawl alungsim ahi zomah hi.
Piltak in agamta a, atapate tengteng Judah gam leh Benjamin gam tengteng kulh nei khopite ah a-om zaksak vek a; nek ding tampi apia a, zi tampi azonsak chiat hi.
